displayName: Live demo: /healthz failing from several regions

documentation.content: Cloud Monitoring's uptime check `arabica-intake-healthz` calls `https://factored-hackathon-2026-arabicaai.lucas-tramonte.workers.dev/healthz` every 5 minutes from several regions and expects `"status":"ok"` (the Worker's D1 ping). This fires when more than one region fails for 5 minutes: the Worker or D1 is down for customers. Check Workers & Pages → factored-hackathon-2026-arabicaai → Observability, query `event = "unhandled_error"`. Source: scripts/gcp/monitoring/README.md.
